observations.why: The collective 'We ratified' enacts communal-sharing: a group body concurring on a shared contract, undifferentiated we-ness performing ratification.

evidence.quote: no lost work if the client drops the receipt

observations.why: The consequence-for-choice framing — loss avoidance tied to a specific client action — enacts market-pricing proportionality: cost of dropping a receipt measured against work preservation.

evidence.quote: remember dispatches, then the agent either polls

observations.why: The dispatch-then-poll structure assigns asymmetric roles: 'remember' commands, 'the agent' obeys by polling — a hierarchical allocation of initiative and response.
